nodes.name: wooden crate
nodes.caption: A weathered wooden crate with metal reinforcements and a diagonal X-brace on its lid, stacked atop another similar crate; it has a rough, dusty texture and appears aged, positioned in the left foreground under a canvas tent support.

nodes.name: retro-futuristic robot
nodes.caption: A small, retro-futuristic robot with a spherical glass-domed head, metallic segmented body, backpack-like gear, and articulated limbs; it sits crouched on a wooden crate, holding a small tool or weapon, with visible rivets and wear marks suggesting field use.

nodes.name: off-road vehicle
nodes.caption: A rugged, off-road utility vehicle resembling a Land Rover Defender, painted in faded beige with dust and grime; it features a roof rack loaded with cargo bundles, large all-terrain tires, and a utilitarian boxy shape, parked diagonally in the midground.

nodes.name: stone obelisk
nodes.caption: A tall, monolithic stone obelisk with hieroglyphic carvings running vertically along its four faces, tapering to a pyramidal top; it stands upright on a broad stone base, partially illuminated by sunset light, casting a long shadow in the desert camp setting.

nodes.name: stacked wooden crates
nodes.caption: A stack of three wooden crates of varying sizes: bottom one is large and dark-stained, middle is medium with metal bands, top is smaller and lighter-colored with a latch; they are arranged in a slightly offset tower on the right side of the scene, near a rolled leather bundle.

nodes.name: wooden crate
nodes.caption: A single medium-sized wooden crate with metal corner protectors and a central latch, placed on the floor to the right of the rolled leather bundle; its surface shows scuff marks and dust, consistent with outdoor storage.

nodes.name: rolled leather bundle
nodes.caption: A cylindrical rolled leather or canvas bundle secured with two metal buckled straps, lying horizontally on a low wooden crate in the foreground right; its surface is worn and creased, suggesting frequent transport or use in arid conditions.

nodes.name: tent support pole
nodes.caption: A thick, rough-hewn wooden pole supporting a canvas tent canopy, angled diagonally from upper left toward lower right; it shows natural wood grain and minor splintering, with rope lashings visible near its top attachment point.
